description:
Activate Diamond Lion's unearth ability by paying {1}{B}{R}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {B/R}{B/R}{B/R}.
Choose to exile Diamond Lion using Void Maw's replacement effect instead of its unearth replacement effect.
Activate Void Maw by putting Diamond Lion from exile into your graveyard, giving Void Maw +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
